Staying in Virginia Together: Heather, Wesley & Our Six-Person Home

2001–2032 • Pavilion Reunion, Ten Campuses, Secular Wedding, Alaskan King & Two Mirrored Suites

Follow Heather and Wesley from Emerald Creek Mall and Graduation 2003 at the Virginia Beach Pavilion—where Nate and Katie welcome Heather back for Wesley's sake and Aunt Linda stays in Virginia—through their ten-campus summer tour, Monticello Avenue rescue, Route 250 hotel week, 2008 secular wedding, South Richmond 'I object!' showdown, migrating full-time onto their solid-oak Alaskan King, and Senator Katie Prairie's 2028 Supported Companions Act.
